title: Unnecessary Adhesive
text:
Unnecessary Adhesive. The maker of this product attaches a big label inside the colander. Pulling off this large circular label left behind sticky adhesive residue. For a long time I tried to clean it with soap. No success. It was still there and sticky. I then tried vinegar. No success. The only way to clean it was using Goo Gone. Keep in mind, however, that this is a product to use with food. It's not a pleasant thought to have to use Goo Gone on something you'll be using with food you're gonna eat.

I had to spend way too much time removing adhesive on something that should not have had any adhesive on it in the first place.
